correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the closed-neighborhood marking and single-unmonitored-neighbor forcing. Sensor columns are initially complete; adjacent complete columns force global propagation; a pair of occupied columns of weights a,b at cyclic gap d<a+b forces completion via explicit d=1,2,3 cases. Summing required gaps d>=a+b gives n>=2|S|; single occupied column n=3 edge case handled. Alternating nonadjacent one-sensor columns in one row stall at floor(n/2). Independent direct enumeration for n=3,4,5,6 gives extrema 1,2,2,3 and 9,18,30,24 attaining subsets; tests are finite corroboration, not the n-uniform proof.
